description: Phase 5: Integration with Backtrack MainWindow - Add Presenter launch button to MainWindow, wire up AudioEngine events (SectionChanged, PositionChanged, PlaybackStopped) to MidiPresenterSync/PresenterEngine, shared Song loading, ServiceOrder drives entire flow.
steps: Add a 'Presenter' button to WorshipPlayer.UI/Views/MainWindow.xaml in the toolbar area. Clicking it launches the OperatorWindow.

Create WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs - a service that: (a) creates and holds PresenterEngine, MidiPresenterSync, ServiceOrderManager, DisplayManager, StageDisplayServer instances; (b) subscribes to AudioEngine.SectionChanged and forwards to MidiPresenterSync.OnBacktrackSectionChanged; (c) subscribes to AudioEngine.PositionChanged and forwards to MidiPresenterSync.OnPlaybackPositionUpdate; (d) subscribes to AudioEngine.PlaybackStopped and calls MidiPresenterSync.OnSongEnded; (e) when a song is loaded in the backtrack, calls PresenterEngine.OnSongLoaded; (f) provides pitch/tempo change forwarding.
Update WorshipPlayer.UI/Views/MainWindow.xaml.cs to instantiate PresenterIntegration on load, pass it the AudioEngine reference, and wire up the Presenter button to open OperatorWindow.
Add project reference from WorshipPlayer.UI to WorshipPlayer.Presenter in the UI csproj.

Ensure ServiceOrder drives the flow: when ServiceOrderManager.ItemChanged fires for a Song item, auto-load that song in the backtrack player AND load its slides in the presenter. For non-song items, only update the presenter.
Update MainWindow.xaml.cs to support loading a ServiceOrder that pre-populates the song list (existing setlist functionality migrated to ServiceOrder).
acceptance_criteria: MainWindow has a Presenter button that opens the OperatorWindow
AudioEngine section changes are forwarded to PresenterEngine
AudioEngine position updates drive timestamp-based slide advance
Song loading in backtrack triggers slide generation in presenter
ServiceOrder items drive both backtrack and presenter
findings: Build succeeds with 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings). All 93 tests pass. PresenterIntegration requires System.IO using directive. The PresenterSettings is instantiated with defaults since AppSettings does not have a PresenterSettings field yet - if needed later, it can be deserialized from settings.json. The stage server start is fire-and-forget since it runs on Kestrel background thread.
